name: FrogUI Component Registry
description: Index of canonical FrogUI components for cross-platform consumption, documentation generation, and developer tooling.

categories.description: Interactive elements that trigger user operations, submissions, and state transitions.
Form controls, text fields, toggles, and selection controls for collecting user input.
Cards, badges, lists, and avatars for organizing and presenting application data.
Indicators, alerts, and progress states communicating status to the user.
Tabs, rails, bars, and segmented controls for hierarchical and peer navigation.
Modals, dialogs, bottom sheets, and tooltips presented above primary surfaces.
Structural scaffolds, spacers, containers, and responsive grids.
